source_hashes.note: Derived from the D1 candidate frozen 2026-11-15. Six question texts and their rubric propositions were made team-neutral; no facet, qualifier, priority or ID changed.

question_manifest.question_text: What residential real-estate markets does your team actively serve? Identify primary cities/counties and secondary relocation markets.
What types of buyers currently make up your business? For example, first-time buyers, move-up buyers, relocations, investors, cash buyers, and returning clients.
Approximately what proportion of your buyer business comes from each major segment? Estimates are acceptable.
What languages does your team use for marketing, prospect communications, and appointments?
What is your primary value proposition to homebuyers? Why should a prospective buyer choose your team?
What problems or concerns usually motivate prospects to contact you?
Do different buyer types receive different onboarding, financing, or appointment processes?
Which prospect types tend to convert into active buyers, and which frequently stall?
What makes your team's buying experience meaningfully different from other agents' processes?
What buyer outcomes would you most like your system to improve, and how would you define measurable success?
List every active buyer lead source: paid Meta advertising, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, organic content, websites, referrals, seminars, open houses, database reactivation, or others.
Which sources currently generate the greatest lead volume?
For each major source, what exactly does the advertisement or content promise the viewer?
What action is the prospect instructed to take—submit a form, send a DM, comment a keyword, call, register, or book directly?
What information is requested before the prospect becomes a lead?
Do prospects expect a consultation, a list of homes, an affordability assessment, a financing conversation, an educational resource, or something else?
Are there important differences in intent between paid-social and organic-social leads?
